consumer.notes:
Thank you for using the Water Polo Board.

New in this version:
- A Board left stuck by an interrupted update now recovers on its own.
- A Board now says when it is busy updating or searching.
- Only one device searches for a scoreboard at a time.
- Improved sharing of one Board between several apps.
- Groundwork for Water Polo Log to control Water Polo Camera through the Board.
